findings.title: Parenthesize the base authorization fragment when no filters exist
findings.body: For org/team scopes without service-level filters, `authConditions` contains a top-level OR between team bookings and members' personal bookings, and this branch returns it without enclosing parentheses. Composing the new fragment as `WHERE ${baseConditions} AND <date/status predicate>` therefore applies the additional predicate only to the personal-booking branch; all matching team bookings bypass it. The previous `findMany` implementation combined authorization and caller conditions structurally with AND. Return a parenthesized fragment here as well, and test an org/team query with an additional predicate to preserve that behavior.
